author: cairn
blurb: A daily GitHub PR summary: open, reviewable, and stale pull requests.

definition.name: GitHub PR digest
definition.description: Summarises open pull requests via the GitHub connector and drafts a review note.
definition.instructions: Using the attached GitHub connector, list open pull requests in the project's repositories. Write a 'GitHub PR digest — <date>' note with sections: Needs review (PRs awaiting review, with title and author), Blocked or stale (PRs open 5+ days with no activity), and Ready to merge (PRs whose checks passed). Recommend at most the 3 most important PRs to review first. Do NOT merge, close, comment on, or change any PR — read and summarise only. If the connector isn't attached, write a one-line note saying so.
